en: Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a panorama of the town of Gersdorf near Chemnitz. In the foreground are timber-framed and smaller houses, behind them a large multi‑storey school building with many windows, and further to the right a tall neo‑Gothic church with a slender spire and clock tower. The landscape in the background is rural fields. The caption in red German text is at the top, and the printer's credit and year appear at the bottom.
